item.title: A mixture of belongings and rubbish, 19th September
item.description:
There is a significant amount of rubbish and discarded belongings left outside the neighbouring property, which appears to be currently unoccupied. The items have been left directly outside our house and are clearly visible from our front door, as shown in the attached photograph. This has been there for several weeks, possibly up to a month, and we have seen no indication that anyone is coming to collect or remove it. We believe the previous occupants may have vacated the property and left the items behind. We would be grateful if the Council could investigate and arrange for the rubbish to be removed, as it is becoming an ongoing nuisance and is affecting the appearance of the area.

item.title: Road patches damaging bottom of cars! Are they finished or abandoned?, 19th September
item.description:
On the 3rd September 2026 there was some work road patching done all up the following road: 405355 LANE TO HARDWICKE HOUSE ELMSTONE HARDWICKE, ELMSTONE HARDWICKE, CHELTENHAM It seemed no one in the houses around this road knew it would be happened by and the road wasn’t even in a particularly bad state But that’s beside the point, since then no one has came back and all up the road in around 30 patches around 40cm x 70cm that are incredibly textured and are scrape the bottom of everyone’s cars that aren’t as high off the ground at incredibly low speeds. When is the road going to finished/fixed from this? It’s either go 5mph and scrap our vehicles to get out onto the main road or take the cross road junction of that road which is 50mph and incredibly dangerous now with the amount of traffic down the road (USRN: 40100456) due to new developments and diversions. The sight to get out is very limited and my families 4x cars have all nearly been extremely close to be crashing into around 10 times already. I appreciate the proactive road fixing but this is dangerous and damaging vehicles.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Tewkesbury
